must_find.summary: The separator conversion `filename.replace(/\\/, '/')` (after/src/utils/filepath.ts:26, same in after/deno_dist/utils/filepath.ts:26) has no `g` flag, so only the first backslash is converted. A multi-segment path keeps mixed separators: getFilePath({ filename: 'foo\\bar\\baz.txt' }) returns 'foo/bar\\baz.txt' (and 'public/foo/bar\\baz.txt' with root 'public') instead of 'foo/bar/baz.txt', which resolves to the wrong file or 404s. The new tests only use single-backslash paths after stripping the leading one, so they miss it.
